name: Rome2Rio
description:
Rome2Rio helps you figure out how to get anywhere in the world.
Ask for any trip—from local routes to global journeys—and instantly see ways to get there by train, bus, ferry, car, flight, and even combinations of each, all in one place. The map makes it easy to view and compare your travel options.
You’ll get clear, door-to-door route options with travel times, connections, and estimated prices. When available, Rome2Rio also shows schedules and ticket details so you can plan with confidence.
Whether you’re comparing transport modes, mapping a complex itinerary, or making on-the-go decisions, Rome2Rio makes it easy to understand your options and choose the best way to get there.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rome2Rio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rome2Rio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://chatgpt-app.rome2rio.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rome2Rio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rome2Rio provides these MCP tools: get-routes and get-schedules.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rome2Rio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Rome2Rio in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Rome2Rio does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
